what: On hover, the fill of the pill button shrinks in .5s into a dot of radius 12px at the right end (20px in), revealing fill-colored text underneath. .6s later a white arrow lights up inside the dot and nudges 2px and back (.8s). When the cursor leaves, the fill spreads out again.

options.--fx-fill: Fill color (via style or css), default --kf-ink — accent button is --kf-accent
options.--fx-on: Text and arrow color over the fill, default --kf-surface
options.--fx-base: Background color revealed once the paint clears, default --kf-surface
options.--fx-dot-x: Distance of the dot center from the right edge, default 20px — small button 14px
options.--fx-arrow-x: Arrow offset to the right, default 13.5px — small button 10.5px
options.--fx-dur: Length of the fill shrinking, default .5s
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Button text (required) — builds a cover from the same text and shrinks it along with the fill
options.--fx-text-dot: Dot radius the text cover shrinks to, default --fx-dot — the original shrank them separately, 12px for the fill and 8px for the text
options.--fx-text-dot-x: Centered dot position of the text overlay, default --fx-dot-x

use: READ MORE — Pill shape (border-radius) and height are set in the consuming css
note: In the original, hover applies only at 1024px and up (@media (min-width:1024px)) — the part also shrinks only at (hover: hover) and (min-width: 1024px). Touch screens stay filled as they are

from.where: shared.css .mr-btn all pill buttons (READ MORE·VIEW DETAIL·BUY·CONTACT) — original .c-button.is-hover__arrow (::before·.c-button__animationText clip-path circle(12px at calc(100% - 20px) 50%) .5s, text color .2s .6s, ::after arrow .8s .6s), header CONTACT uses circle(8px at calc(100% - 14px)) · arrow 6px
